question: The first-party Rage4 pricing page states 'Unlimited records and requests' on the free tier, while older third-party reviews cite a 250,000-query cap and per-million query overage fees; is there a real query quota on the free tier, and does the free tier require a card at signup beyond email and password?
why: No query cap or overage line appears on any first-party page read, so no number was invented; the live signup URL rage4.com/Secure/Register answered HTTP 404 on 2026-11-19 and its form was read from a 2026-09-30 Wayback capture. An account or a live DNS probe would settle both points.
